meta.title: Set up Multi Currency with conversion factors
gaps: Directly verify that vendors can submit bids in each added currency at the configured conversion rates.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify that vendors can submit bids in each added currency at the configured conversion rates.

steps.note: Open a new event create screen where event currency configuration can be accessed.
Provide the required event title for a create test.

args.goal: On the new event create screen, open the Edit Currencies control at the bottom-left, select Multi Currency, tick each currency the case allows, enter a valid conversion factor for every selected currency, click OK, reopen Edit Currencies, and stop with Multi Currency selected and the ticked currencies and conversion factors visibly shown.

steps.note: Perform and verify the currency configuration and persistence because no dedicated catalog step can operate or inspect Edit Currencies.
Confirm the reopened currency editor visibly shows the Multi Currency mode.
